=== Getting started with [http://code.google.com/p/givwenzen GivWenZen] ===

 * To use GWZ you need to add the givwenzen.jar and the dependencies below.

 * To use GWZ with the slim testing system use the {{{org.givwenzen.GivWenZenForSlim}}} by adding the following table to a tests.
-----
{{{
|import|
|org.givwenzen|

|script|
|start|giv wen zen for slim|
}}}
-----

 * Add a step to the test created in step 2.
-----
|given|this is a simple step|
-----

 * Create a StepClass in the default step package bdd.steps.
----
{{{
@DomainStep("this is a simple step")
public boolean simpleStep() {
  return true;
}
}}}
----

 * Run the test

=== Dependencies: ===
==== required for main classes: ====
 * commons-logging.jar
 * google-collect-snapshot-20080530.jar
 * javassist.jar
 * log4j-1.2.9.jar
 * reflections-0.9.2.jar

==== additional requirements for test classes ====
 * junit-4.5.jar
 * hamcrest-core-1.1.jar
 * javassist.jar
 * json.jar
 * mockito-core-1.7.jar
 * objenesis-1.0.jar
